title: Enforce mandatory isolated worktrees and Susi Native Board collaboration across Core runtime, swarms, harness, A2A, daemon/GMCP, and workflows
goal: Guarantee every Core agent (local, cloud, parallel fleet, DAG, speculative mission, harness, A2A, local-workflow, git hooks) runs in its own isolated local Git worktree and collaborates strictly through the Susi Native Board by default with HTTP + Git transports and no bypass path.

reuse.reason: Reuses susi-core plain_http and HighDensityContextStore, susi-harness ParallelWorkflowHarness worktree layout, and susi-commercial susi-board-item-v1 schema/ref protocol to bridge Core and Commercial native board collaboration without new third-party dependencies.
